findings.detail: This non-primary leaf parses existing antiSMASH annotations and does not detect BGCs from assembled genomes.
This non-primary leaf builds EI GC-MS networks rather than feature-based LC-MS/MS molecular families.
The primary leaf builds classic GNPS molecular networks but explicitly excludes the feature-based workflow requested by this stage.
The primary leaf reports rank comparisons for validated links rather than a consolidated provenance-bearing table of all scored links.
